status.en: 83 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 35% fewer than the week before, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 83 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 35 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: The Israeli President has named a candidate to try forming the next government while opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot reports progress in coalition talks and faces easing of ultra-Orthodox draft opposition. Israeli settlers seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens, and the IDF arrested three Palestinians planning terror attacks in the West Bank. In Gaza, gunfire damaged tents at the Rafah displacement site as aid teams prepared for winter storms, and residents built wind turbines from rubble and turned discarded cooking pots into seawalls. 21,440 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den israelske presidenten har utpekt en kandidat til å prøve å danne neste regjering mens opposisjonslederen Gadi Eisenkot rapporterer fremgang i koalisjonsforhandlingene og møter en lettelse av motstanden fra de ultraortodokse mot verneplikt. Israelske bosettere tok over åtte palestinske hjem i Jeriko, og forflyttet dusinvis, og IDF arresterte tre palestinere som planla terrorangrep på Vestbredden. I Gaza ble telt på Rafah-flyktningesteder skadet av skudd mens hjelpearbeidere forberedte seg på vinterstormer, og innbyggere bygde vindturbiner av ruiner og gjorde om kastede gryter til sjøvoller. 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
